We're thrilled to announce that the recordings of talks and workshops from the third **R/Pharma genAI** day are now available! You can access all of the individual recordings on the R/Pharma [YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@RinPharma){target="_blank"} or head directly to the [2026 GenAI Day Playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLEozv0atVie0){target="_blank"}.

{{< video https://youtu.be/-LTJb9HkQvs?si=KDMqTQxFH3yNb4p3 >}}

This year's collection of talks and workshops illustrate a growing trend of how the life sciences industry is starting to find consistency in the foundational layers of open-source packages to power innovation with AI. From the practical perspectives on building agentic workflows, embedding safe guardrails in custom agents, and learning the fundamentals behind skills, there is a wealth of knowledge available for you. On behalf of our organizing and program committees, we extend a huge thank you to the speakers for all of their time and effort to share their experiences in this year's event!
